segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company with no operations, seeking a business combination with a target business.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated in the Cayman Islands on September 1, 2025, as an exempted company, formed for the purpose of entering into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or other similar business combination with one or more target businesses or entities.
